in_sanskrit.name: Mahalakshmi
in_sanskrit.meaning: Great Goddess of Wealth and Prosperity
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mahalakshmi is the goddess of wealth, fortune, prosperity, luxury, and auspiciousness. She is the consort of Lord Vishnu and is considered the embodiment of his divine grace and protection.

in_marathi.name: Malkhan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Wealth, Fortune
in_marathi.long_meaning: Malkhan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Malkhan is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Malak' which means 'god' or 'deity'.
